records.text: Owens said Charlie Kirk attended an event in Korea on September 5 and 6, 2025, then went to Japan and appeared on CNN News Japan on September 7.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: You have Charlie on the 5th and on the 6th of September. He is in Korea doing an event. ... And then on the 7th, he's in Japan, and he is on CNN News Japan speaking.

verification.notes: First-party event pages establish the September 5-6 South Korea conference and September 7 Tokyo speech. CNN confirms that Kirk gave it an interview in Japan three days before his September 10 death. The legacy phrase CNN News Japan was normalized to the supported fact that he gave CNN an interview while in Japan.

records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And according to his LinkedIn, he was the marksmanship instructor for the Marines from 2009 to 2014 at Camp Pendleton, which is in California. ... He's been deployed in combat in Afghanistan. He was also deployed in humanitarian work in Japan for the Marines before he arrived into Utah.

verification.notes: Owens's episode says Robertson's LinkedIn listed Marine marksmanship instruction from 2009 to 2014 at Camp Pendleton and deployments to Afghanistan and Japan. Live searches found a current LinkedIn profile and secondary screenshots supporting Marine service and Afghanistan/Japan deployments, but the accessible LinkedIn page did not expose the cited employment details and no authoritative record confirmed the 2009-2014 marksmanship-instructor entry. The citation could not be conclusively checked.
